verdict: Meta is delivering leads; Google coverage gap arrives as heating season opens.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all 15 tracked leads came through Meta at $47.86 cost per lead on $717.90 in spend — a solid return. Google Ads spent $795.28 in the same window with no trackable leads, a dollar-for-dollar inversion that left heating-season search coverage thin precisely when it matters most. Heating campaigns on both Google and Meta are being activated this week to close that gap before peak demand builds. Your Quality HVAC Solutions Google Business Profile is also being optimized — it drew over 1,000 impressions this period but converted calls at a lower rate than your second listing, and tightening that listing is an near-term priority. Expect lead volume to shift as the Google campaigns come online and fall creative rolls out.
